taglines: It's Tuesday, which is Monday with a day of scar tissue on it. You survived yesterday but that only means more was delegated to today. The inbox is waiting. It has been waiting. It is very patient.

The thing you said you would follow up on Monday you will now follow up on today, Tuesday, while also doing everything you were supposed to do on Tuesday. You are a time machine that only goes forward and always arrives late.

Somewhere in your task manager is a task called 'clean up task manager.' It has been there for eleven weeks. It is the oldest task. It predates the goals it was supposed to help you achieve. It is a fossil.
You have 47 browser tabs open. Three of them are useful. One of them is playing music you forgot about. One of them is something you were going to read 'later.' Later has not arrived in four years.

The roadmap said Q2. Q2 ended fifteen days ago. The roadmap has not been updated because updating the roadmap requires a meeting, and the meeting requires a calendar invite, and everyone is busy doing the things that aren't on the roadmap.

Your most productive hours are 10am to noon. You have used them for email, two standup calls, and a Slack thread about whether to use Slack or a different tool. It is now 12:01 PM. The real work begins after lunch, you tell yourself, as you always tell yourself.

Someone said 'circle back' four times in your last call. The circle has been back so many times it has achieved a stable orbit. Nothing is getting closer to a decision. The circle back is the decision.

Tuesday is just a theory. In practice it is a series of things that were supposed to happen Monday, plus new things that happened because Monday happened, plus the ambient hum of everything that was due last week and has simply gone quiet in a way that is not the same as resolved.
